name: Mobile Spellcasting
body:
You have learned to cast spells while on the move.

Prerequisite(s): Caster level 3rd

Benefit(s): You can make a concentration check (DC 15 + double the spell level) when casting a spell. If the check succeeds, you can cast the spell and move up to your speed as a single standard action. The spell cast must be a standard action or less. If the check fails, you lose the spell and fail to cast it, just as if you had failed a concentration check to cast the spell defensively, but you still can move. You provoke attacks of opportunity for casting spells from any creatures who threaten you at any point of your movement and from the movement itself. You can cast defensively while using this feat, but doing so increases the concentration DC to 20 + double the spell level.
